title: Abelian heart origin of a finite constant module sheaf on a slice
statement: Let X be any scheme, B a finite commutative ring in the scheme universe, R a commutative ring sheaf on X_proet, phi:constant(B)->R an isomorphism, M an R-module sheaf, and V an etale chart. Suppose that on every etale chart W->V a covering sieve trivializes M into scalar extensions along phi of finite constant B-modules, using [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-quotient-model-data]. Then there exists an etale ULift(B)-module sheaf G on V.left whose restriction to every etale chart admits a covering family of finite constant module models, and an isomorphism comparisonUpperStar(G) ~= F_V(M), where F_V is [def-weil-pbc-finite-coefficient-slice-restriction]. This is a statement only about one sheaf in the abelian heart; it has no complex, cohomological bounds or derived-model transport.

proof.text: Restriction along the ring-sheaf isomorphism is an equivalence, with inverse restriction along its inverse. Uniqueness of left adjoints identifies ordinary tensor extension with that inverse. Hence restriction cancels completedAdicChange. The constant-scalar sheafification comparison identifies koszulConstantFunctor with the fixed-module constant sheaf. Apply these comparisons on each supplied slice trivialization.

Apply the hypothesis only to V and its identity. The covering-sieve point criterion chooses one member Z_x through each point of V.left. These etale maps form a proetale cover of V.left. Under weakly etale slice localization the fixed-module slice models become constant sheaves on Z_x.left; pullback composition and the triangle Z_x -> V -> X identify them with models of the specified coordinate restriction. A finitely generated module over finite B, and its universe lift, are finite sets.

Apply etale_origin_of_finite_models on V.left to obtain G, its finite local constancy, and the marking by comparisonUpperStar. The proved local_finite_module_models helper restricts finite local trivializations to each etale chart, expressing the covering as Sieve.ofArrows and the finite model as a finitely generated module.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteCoefficient_slice_heart_origin
    (X : Scheme.{t})
    (B : Type t) [CommRing B] [Finite B]
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{t + 1})
    (φ : adicConstantRing X B ⟶ R) (hφ : IsIso φ)
    (M : SheafOfModules.{t + 1} ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R)) (V : X.Etale)
    (hloc : let R₀ := ((sheafCompose (ProEt.topology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{t + 1} RingCat.{t + 1})).obj R);
      ∀ (W : X.Etale) (g : W ⟶ V),
        ∃ S : Sieve W, S ∈ X.smallEtaleTopology W ∧
          ∀ (Z : X.Etale) (f : Z ⟶ W), S f →
            ∃ N : ModuleCat.{t} B, Module.Finite B N ∧ Nonempty
              ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
                  M ≅
                (SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{t + 1} R₀ ((toProEt X).obj Z)).obj
                  ((completedAdicChange X φ).obj
                    ((ModuleCat.uliftFunctor.{t + 1, t} B ⋙
                  ModuleCat.restrictScalars.{t + 1}
                    (ULift.ringEquiv : ULift.{t + 1} B ≃+* B).toRingHom ⋙
                  koszulConstantFunctor X B).obj N)))) :
    ∃ G : Sheaf V.left.smallEtaleTopology (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B)),
      (∀ W : V.left.Etale,
        ∃ (I : Type (t + 1)) (U : I → V.left.Etale) (f : ∀ i, U i ⟶ W),
          Sieve.ofArrows U f ∈ V.left.smallEtaleTopology W ∧
          ∀ i, ∃ N : ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B),
            Module.Finite (ULift.{t + 1} B) N ∧ Nonempty
              (G.over (U i) ≅
                (constantSheaf (V.left.smallEtaleTopology.over (U i))
                  (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B))).obj N)) ∧
      Nonempty ((comparisonUpperStar (ModuleCat.{t + 1} (ULift.{t + 1} B)) V.left).obj G ≅
        (finiteCoefficientSliceRestriction X B R φ V).obj M)
